audit_after: the levers serving [R-MACRO-01] are complete — the house inflation ladder, the currency derived from it and the terminal risk-free derived from it are ONE rule in three places, and the natural place to stop and look is when that rule has finished moving the answer

levers.name: terminal on the disclosed life; growth stored as a real rate
levers.why: the terminal was the retired reinvestment identity, whose implied replacement cycle is 1/g — 20.0 years at the old 5% against a weighted useful life of 13.80 the company itself discloses
levers.evidence: FY2024 audited note 3.1 lives weighted by note 4.1's gross cost

levers.name: re-struck on the latest known price; lens record committed
levers.why: the study was struck against a price four weeks old

levers.name: domestic inflation moved to the house ladder; currency re-derived from it
levers.why: the study carried its own Egyptian inflation path, named in no growth line, driving the cost stack AND the purchasing-power wedge

levers.name: terminal risk-free derived rather than quoted
levers.why: 10.5% was the central bank's 5% TARGET plus the real convention while every other long-run rate in the model ran on 7%

levers.name: currency conformed to the house derivation's own anchor
levers.why: a first draft anchored FY2026 at the observed spot; the house derivation does not admit a leading-year anchor for a currency and the study conforms rather than inventing one
levers.evidence: the tension in the house path's first year is registered, not resolved

levers: terminal on the disclosed life; growth stored as a real rate
re-struck on the latest known price; lens record committed
domestic inflation moved to the house ladder; currency re-derived from it
terminal risk-free derived rather than quoted
currency conformed to the house derivation's own anchor

note: Several levers serving ONE rule are one piece of evidence, not several. `rules` combines them; `levers` keeps the order they were applied in so the route can be walked.
